title: Story: a checked view over board sets, for one audience and one protagonist

title.description: one line; for an invented story the title says so

version.description: its state.version when the story was made

sha256.description: sha256 of the board file the story was made from

boards.description: the stamp of each board set the story reads; a change of version or sha means regenerate

audience.description: element id of the party the story is told to

protagonist.description: element id of the party the story is about; the audience may be the protagonist

allow.description: curated allow-list: the only ids the audience may see; a human sets it, the engine only checks the sentences against it

path.description: element ids in the order of the walk; each neighbour pair is joined by a typed link

conflict.description: the conflict objects: opposes pairs, normality boundaries, a series of linked events, red lines in breach

resolution.description: the cooperation, function chain or goal the path reaches; empty when the board has none, and the story says so

open.description: hypotheses the story ends on, as questions

ids.description: board ids the sentence rests on; empty is reported by the check (G1)

level.description: the strength the sentence claims; never above the weakest of its ids (G2)

part.description: the part of the form: situation, complication, question, answer for scqa

voice.description: who wrote the story; ai, since a story is always a draft of the engine (G7)

run.description: the procedure run that wrote the sentences, as on a board set
